summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing proposed amendments to its memorandum and articles of association to align with Hong Kong Listing Rules' Corporate Governance Code, and to convene its annual general meeting on June 12, 2026. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The board recommends voting in favor of the proposed resolutions. This is a routine governance update and ordinary meeting notice, not a special situation. Watch for shareholder approval at the AGM, but no actionable risk-arb angle exists.
